pages.title: Native Spellcasting
pages.text: Learn and improve existing spells from Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks. Their mana costs, cooldowns, and casting rules still apply.$(br2)Spell ranks can extend how long you may charge. Fireball grows as you hold it; configured Firebolt upgrades add bursts. Release to cast after the minimum cast time.

pages.title: Unlock and Prepare
pages.text: Hold a spell node to unlock it, then open Spells and assign it to an available slot. Choose hotbar sets or a shared quick-cast set.$(br2)Higher spell levels can unlock more modifier slots. Base spell-level upgrades and extra charge ranks are separate improvements.

pages.title: Charging Spells
pages.text: The charge bar fills as a percentage, with marks at each charge level. Select an active node to read its spell description.
